paras.text: The game always starts with the batting of the guest team, which is called The Top. The host team will take the second batting, which is called The bottom. When the umpire starts the game he calls “Play”, and if for some reason the game has to be stopped, he will call “Time”.

paras.urdu: کھیل کے آغاز سے قبل امپائر کو ٹیم منیجر کی جانب سے کھلاڑیوں کے ناموں اور بیٹنگ کی ترتیب کی فہرست مہیا کی جاتی ہے۔ کھلاڑی اس ترتیب کے مطابق بیٹنگ کریں گے۔ ہر کھلاڑی اپنی باری پر بیٹر باکس (Batter's box) میں آئے گا۔ بیٹر بال کو زوردار طریقے سے مارتے ہوئے رنز بنانے کی کوشش کرے گا۔
paras.pashto: د لوبې له پیل مخکې امپایر ته د ټیم مدیر له خوا د لوبغاړو د نومونو او د بیټنګ د ترتیب لېست ورکول کېږي. لوبغاړي به د دې ترتیب سره سم بیټنګ کوي. هر لوبغاړی به په خپل وار د بیټر بکس (Batter's box) ته راځي. بیټر به په زوروره توګه توپ وهي او د منډو جوړولو هڅه به کوي.

sections.theory:
The dress of the players consists of trousers and a shirt, on which the numbers should be clear.

Every fielder is allowed to wear a leather glove (Glove).

Officials of Match

Chief umpire (Chief Umpire)

3 or 4 umpires

Official scorer

Start of the game

The game always starts with the batting of the guest team, which is called The Top. The host team will take the second batting, which is called The bottom. When the umpire starts the game he calls “Play”, and if for some reason the game has to be stopped, he will call “Time”.

Batting

Before the start of the game a list of the names of the players and the order of batting is provided to the umpire by the team manager. The players will bat according to this order. Every player on his turn will come into the batter’s box (Batter's box). The batter will try to make runs by hitting the ball in a powerful way.
